blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—A 51-year-old construction worker died on the spot after being struck by lightning while working at a dump in Labangan town in this province, Friday afternoon, Oct. 9. The Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) identified the victim as Dominador Labora, a resident of Purok Santan, Upper Pulacan, Labangan. Initial investigation by the Labangan Municipal Police Station revealed that the incident occurred around 3 p.m. at Purok 7, Barangay Bokong, near the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) Dam. Labora was working alongside three co-workers at the site when sudden lightning struck him, causing severe fatal injuries. […]...
